The '''Secret Garden''' (Japanese: '''秘密の庭''' ''Secret Garden'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Alto Mare]], [[Johto]]. It was featured in ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]''.

==In animation==
[[File:Secret Garden at dusk.png|thumb|left|250px|The Secret Garden at dusk]]
In the film, the Secret Garden is the home of the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Latias}} and {{p|Latios}}. It is also home to other [[wild Pokémon]], and of the extremely rare [[Soul Dew]]. It is an incredibly large place surrounded by a stone wall, and has many fountains made of brick and contains grassy fields, all sorts of flowers, and both natural and man-made ponds, trees varying in size and essentially looks like a Venetian garden. It is invisible to outsiders. Its existence is only known by few people, including {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, {{an|Brock}}, {{OBP|Bianca|M05}}, and [[Lorenzo]].

During the film, the thieves {{OBP|Annie|M05}} and [[Oakley]] found out about the Secret Garden, sneaked in, captured {{OBP|Latios|M05}} and stole the Soul Dew. As they wreaked havoc through using the Soul Dew to power the [[Defense Mechanism of Alto Mare]], the Soul Dew became corrupted and was destroyed. As a result, Alto Mare was threatened with destruction by an immense tidal wave. To save the city, Latios sacrificed himself to destroy the tsunami, in the process becoming a new Soul Dew that was later installed in the Secret Garden.

The Secret Garden briefly reappeared in ''[[JN146|Ash and Latios]]'', where Latios and {{an|Latias}} flew through it during their brief visit to the city, flying past the resident {{OBP|Latias|M05}} in her human guise.
